title: Recursive Image Trees · v0.10.6
changes: Any extracted, segmented, or AI-refined image can be the source of another operation; no fixed tree-depth limit.
Branch navigation shows each node's direct children, with next/previous pages and parent navigation without AI charges.
Remove silent 80-object and 500-capture API truncation, preserving existing private image ancestry.
Keep only seven direct children rendered per view for Quest performance; all additional siblings remain available on later pages.
